stories.title: Ethereum ETFs See $206M in Outflows as ETH Holds Near $2,700
stories.summary: US spot Ethereum ETFs recorded $206 million in net outflows, CryptoSlate reported. ETH's price stayed near $2,700 despite the continued selling. Bears kept selling, but the price did not drop further.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF flows show institutional sentiment toward Ethereum, and a stable price despite outflows suggests the selling is being absorbed.
whatToWatch: Next US spot Ethereum ETF flow reports
questions: Who is buying to offset the ETF outflows?
Will outflows continue or reverse in coming days?

sources.title: Ethereum bears keep selling but ETH price stays near $2,700 as US spot ETFs record $206M in outflows

stories.title: Proposed 3x Leveraged Ethereum ETF Could Hit CME Threshold With Just $362M
stories.summary: A proposed 3x leveraged Ethereum ETF could reach the CME futures market threshold with only $362 million in assets, CryptoSlate reported. The low bar reflects how leveraged funds build exposure through futures rather than direct asset purchases.
stories.whyItMatters: A leveraged Ethereum ETF would amplify price swings and could reshape demand for ETH futures if it launches.
whatToWatch: Regulatory status of the proposed ETF
Futures market activity once the threshold is reached
questions: Has the ETF received regulatory approval?
How would leveraged ETF flows affect ETH volatility?

sources.title: Ethereum’s proposed 3x ETF could reach CME’s futures threshold with just $362 million

stories.title: Inflation Data Clouds Bitcoin's Rate-Cut Hopes as Mining Power Shifts
stories.summary: A US services price gauge hit a four-year high, CryptoSlate reported, which dims hopes for near-term interest rate cuts that have supported Bitcoin and other risk assets. Separately, new data show three countries control 66% of global Bitcoin mining, though one rival nation is gaining share.
stories.whyItMatters: Rate-cut expectations move Bitcoin's price, and mining concentration affects network decentralization and geopolitical risk.
whatToWatch: Further shifts in Bitcoin mining hashrate by country
questions: Which country is gaining mining share, and how quickly?
Will this inflation reading change the Fed's rate-cut timeline?

sources.title: US services price gauge hits a four-year high, clouding Bitcoin’s rate-relief outlook
3 countries control 66% of Bitcoin mining, but 1 rival is gaining

stories.title: DOJ Presses Tornado Cash Case as Treasury Drops Mixer Reporting Plan
stories.summary: The Justice Department is pressing forward with its prosecution tied to the Tornado Cash mixing service, CryptoSlate reported. At the same time, the Treasury Department dropped a proposed rule that would have required reporting on crypto mixer transactions.
stories.whyItMatters: The split shows criminal enforcement against mixer use continuing even as broader regulatory reporting rules retreat.
whatToWatch: Next steps in the Tornado Cash prosecution
Whether Treasury proposes a revised mixer reporting rule
questions: Why did Treasury drop the reporting plan while DOJ keeps prosecuting?
Does this affect other pending mixer-related cases?

sources.title: DOJ presses Tornado Cash prosecution as Treasury drops mixer reporting plan

stories.title: Ripple and Circle Back OKX's Push for Stablecoin Growth
stories.summary: Ripple and Circle are backing OKX as the exchange targets a new wave of stablecoin users, CryptoSlate reported. The move links two major stablecoin issuers with one of the larger global exchanges.
stories.whyItMatters: Stablecoin adoption is a key growth area in crypto, and support from issuers like Ripple and Circle could widen OKX's reach.
whatToWatch: Details of the OKX partnership or integration terms
Stablecoin transaction volume on OKX going forward
questions: What form does the backing take — investment, integration, or partnership?

stories.title: Cardano Adds Token Controls That Wall Street Wants — and DeFi May Resist
stories.summary: Cardano added new token control features that appeal to institutional finance, CryptoSlate reported. The same controls could clash with DeFi's open, permissionless design.
stories.whyItMatters: The move shows Cardano courting institutional compliance, a tension that other blockchains face when they seek both regulatory and DeFi adoption.
whatToWatch: Reaction from the Cardano DeFi community
Whether institutions adopt tokens using the new controls
questions: What specific controls did Cardano add?
Will DeFi protocols on Cardano push back against them?

sources.title: Cardano just added the kind of token controls Wall Street wants and DeFi may hate

stories.title: FinCEN Scraps Crypto Mixing Rule After Backlash
stories.summary: The Financial Crimes Enforcement Network dropped its proposed rule targeting crypto mixing services, CryptoSlate reported. The agency pulled the plan after facing significant public backlash.
stories.whyItMatters: The withdrawal is a win for privacy-focused crypto tools and shows a regulator retreating under pressure.
whatToWatch: Whether FinCEN proposes a narrower or revised rule
questions: What specific objections drove the backlash?
Does this affect related Treasury or DOJ actions on mixers?

sources.title: FinCEN drops crypto mixing proposal as backlash kills rule

stories.title: Aave and Pendle Explore Keeping Yield Capital Inside DeFi
stories.summary: Aave and Pendle may have developed a mechanism to keep yield-generating capital circulating within DeFi instead of exiting to other platforms, CryptoSlate reported.
stories.whyItMatters: Keeping capital inside DeFi protocols could boost liquidity and fees across the ecosystem, a key measure of protocol health.
whatToWatch: Launch details and adoption of the mechanism
Effect on Aave and Pendle's total value locked
questions: How does the mechanism technically keep capital from leaving?
What risks do users take on by locking in?

sources.title: Aave and Pendle may have found a way to keep yield capital from ever leaving DeFi

stories.title: China's Crypto Ban Fails to Stop $176 Billion P2P Market
stories.summary: Despite China's ban on crypto trading, a peer-to-peer crypto economy worth $176 billion continues to operate, CryptoSlate reported.
stories.whyItMatters: The figure shows the limits of blanket bans and points to continued demand for crypto access under strict regulation.
whatToWatch: Any new enforcement moves by Chinese authorities
Growth or shrinkage of the P2P market over time
questions: How was the $176 billion figure calculated?
What share of this activity is domestic versus cross-border?

sources.title: China’s crypto ban Is failing to stop a $176 billion P2P economy
